findings.note: Listed as a co-sponsor (not primary) of HB 278, Protect Military Votes. Bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H278v1.html) says: "A covered voter voting under this Article shall not be required to include a photocopy of identification described in G.S. 163-166.16(a) or an affidavit as described in G.S. 163-166.16(d)(1), (d)(2), or (d)(3) when submitting a ballot in accordance with this Article." It would codify that military and overseas absentee voters need no photo ID. The bill was referred to House Rules and did not move.
subjects: photo ID with a military or overseas absentee ballot

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (House roll call 758)
findings.note: Voted No on second reading of HB 958, Election Law Changes (passed 66 to 47 per the votes list). The bill text (edition 8, https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H958v8.html) includes a rule that a voter registration application is processed only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a United States citizen, and voter-roll checks against federal-database information on possible non-citizens.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Motion 11 Concur with Senate changes (House roll call 801)
findings.note: Voted No on the House concurrence vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes (passed 62 to 47 per the votes list). Same bill as the second-reading entry; it carries citizenship-statement and voter-roll non-citizen provisions.

HB 958, Election Law Changes (2025-2026 session). The ratified text includes a requirement that the State Board create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database, and requires an applicant to affirmatively state US citizenship on a voter registration application. Roll call #758, Second Reading: passed 66 to 47.

HB 958, Election Law Changes (2025-2026 session). The ratified text includes a requirement that the State Board create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database, and requires an applicant to affirmatively state US citizenship on a voter registration application. Roll call #801, M11 Concur: passed 62 to 47.

SB 747, Elections Law Changes (2023-2024 session, ratified as SL 2023-140). The ratified text sets same-day registration at early voting sites with a requirement to present photo identification, and lets a voter be challenged for not presenting photo identification. Roll call #542, Second Reading: passed 69 to 47.

SB 747, Elections Law Changes (2023-2024 session, ratified as SL 2023-140). The ratified text sets same-day registration at early voting sites with a requirement to present photo identification, and lets a voter be challenged for not presenting photo identification. Roll call #596, Veto Override: passed 72 to 44.
